C0151.title: Jiangsu Dismantles 'Account Factory': Illegally Obtained Citizen Data Used to Register and 'Fatten' Accounts for Sale
C0151.summary: In April 2026, procuratorial authorities in Jiangsu disclosed a case where a criminal gang illegally obtained citizens' personal information to register various online accounts in bulk, 'fattened' them up, and then sold them for profit. The case involved over 2 million yuan, and 10 suspects including Zhang were arrested.
